targets.identity: The same physical printed card in chairbase-dslr-1 and printed-backrest-20260912; confirmed by Christian on 2026-09-12.
targets.calibration_provenance: Measured anisotropic square pitch imported from index_scanner calibration metadata. card_spec is the canonical numeric calibration in this repository.
targets.reuse: Match family and allocated ID range, then reuse this physical card calibration. A reprint requires a new ID allocation and calibration. Detection identifies the card; it does not measure its printed scale.
